text: In the middle of winter I at last discovered that there was in me an invincible summer.
author: Albert Camus
visual_brief: An engineering cross-section of an insulated thermal core embedded deep within a frozen crystalline shell, depicted in crisp white drafting lines on black. alt: Engineering cross-section of a radiating thermal core inside a cold shell.
